subject.statement: Do Kwon (Do Hyeong Kwon) was sentenced to 15 years in prison on 11 December 2025 by Judge Paul Engelmayer in the case United States v. Do Hyeong Kwon (S.D.N.Y).
disambiguators: United States v. Do Hyeong Kwon (S.D.N.Y.)

summary: As of October 2026, there is no credible record of Do Kwon having been sentenced to 15 years in prison on December 11, 2025 by Judge Paul Engelmayer in the Southern District of New York; he remained awaiting extradition and trial, with no such sentence reported.
